title: 第15章 独狼死第16章 神秘石珠
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
列车站内原本熙熙攘攘、人来人往，但此刻却陷入了死一般的寂静之中。
一场激烈战斗在这里骤然爆发，将周围的一切都被摧毁得狼藉不堪。
赵宇满脸愤怒地瞪着前方，左手紧紧握住铁枪，然后用力往地面插去，竟将铁枪地贯入坚硬的地面之中。
他咬牙切齿地说道：“难道我们就这样眼睁睁地看着，那畜生大摇大摆地离开吗？”言语之间充满了不甘与愤恨。
而躺在一旁地上的道士陈一凡，面色苍白，身体十分虚弱。
他艰难地开口回应道：“不这样看着又能如何呢？那家伙手里有人质啊！而且……”
然而，陈一凡的话还没说完，便被刚刚匆忙赶来的一群黑衣卫，的惊呼声给硬生生打断了。
“队长，您怎么了？”只见人群中突然传出一声惊呼，众人寻声望去。
梁红衣正全身剧烈地颤抖着，仿佛正在承受着一种，非人类所能忍受的痛苦。
她的面容因极度的扭曲，而显得格外狰狞可怕，让人不敢直视。
再仔细一看，只见梁红衣身上熊熊燃烧的血色火焰，正以惊人的速度迅速消退下去。
她的脸色也在这一刻变得煞白，毫无血色，就连呼吸也紊乱不堪起来。
见到此情此景，陈一凡的脸色猛地一变，心中暗叫不好，急忙喊道：“不好！这是队长强行使用血怒后，所带来的严重后遗症。”
赵宇脸色焦急道：“那该怎么办。”
就在这时，梁红衣强忍着浑身剧痛，道：“不用担心我，事情还没完，赵宇，陈一凡你们把这里情况报告给局里，还有检查一下六队成员是否牺牲了。”
听到这里在场所有黑衣卫都有些沉默。
梁红衣有些虚弱接着道：“其他人以四人为小队，继续沿着目标留下的痕迹追踪，记住无论是否找到踪迹，都不可轻举妄动！”
吩咐完这些，梁红衣就眼前一黑，当场晕死过去，刚刚她只不过强撑一口气而已。
不知过了多久，独狼挟持着秦墨雪来到一座废弃厂房里，一把将秦墨雪甩在地上，脸色阴沉道：“小丫头，我不管你打什么主意，最好是老实一点，否则……”
秦墨雪并没有在意身上传来的疼痛，而是偷偷打量下四周，她知道自己生命已经无法掌握，犹如待宰的羔羊，希望自己偷偷洒下的，东西能帮助自己吧！

林道使用瞬步，一路尾随着来到废弃厂房，看着脚下的石灰粉末，眼神里满是赞叹，心里思忖：“身处如此险境，这女孩从来没有放弃过求生，还能冷静的为自己在绝境争取一线生机。”
就凭你这份心性，我便救你一回。
独狼开始打坐恢复伤势，他想要逃离黑衣卫的追捕，就必须争分夺秒，不然等待他就是个死。
大夏黑衣卫是整个超凡者世界的禁忌。
这一次他能逃脱，只是他威胁成功了而已，他用了一列车人的性命，换来黑衣卫失天境无法出手。
只是他没有想到，出来几个后天境的变态，差点把他打死在那里。
几度让他有些怀疑人生。
如果不是他不顾先天的脸面，强行绑架一个普通人，只怕就交待在那里。
秦墨雪看着打坐的男人，并没有任何动作，她知道对方不把自己绑起来，就是不怕自己逃跑，她也没有自讨没趣。
这几个小时时间所经历的事，比她的人生还要精彩刺激的多。
想想车站里精彩绝伦的战斗场景，还有那些神奇的手段，发生的一幕幕，让秦墨雪的心灵感到震撼，也有一种心悸从心底滋生。
趁着独狼疗伤之际，林道瞬步唰一下来到秦墨雪身后。
秦墨雪心口浮现熟悉心悸感，心中一惊，就痛快的眼前一黑晕了过去。
林道在其没反应前，先一步击中秦墨雪后颈，他可不想暴露身份。
独狼似有所感，睁开眼睛，看着眼前少年，心中一沉，能无声无息来到自己身前，才被发现，先天也做不到。
虽然无法察觉到少年实力，但凭借着，刚刚被几个年轻人，按在地上摩擦的经验，面前的少年绝对是个高手。
可惜独狼不知道这个高手有多高。
没有丝毫的犹豫，独狼决定先发制人，口中低声怒喝道：“血狼飞刃！”
随着这声低吼，一股无比强大的真气骤然，从独狼的身躯之中喷涌而出。
整只左手瞬间化作一只狰狞可怖、闪烁着猩红光芒的血色狼爪！
content_en:
The train station was originally bustling with people coming and going, but now it fell into deathly silence.
A fierce battle suddenly broke out here, destroying everything around it.
Zhao Yu stared forward with anger on his face, holding the iron gun tightly with his left hand, and then thrust it hard into the ground, and actually penetrated the iron gun into the hard ground.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Are we just going to watch that beast walk away like this?" His words were full of unwillingness and resentment.
The Taoist priest Chen Yifan lying on the ground nearby was pale and very weak.
He responded with difficulty: "What if I don't look at it like this? That guy has a hostage in his hands! And..."
However, before Chen Yifan could finish his words, he was abruptly interrupted by the exclamations of a group of black-clad guards who had just arrived in a hurry.
"Captain, what's wrong with you?" A sudden cry came from the crowd, and everyone looked for help.
Liang Hongyi was trembling violently all over, as if she was suffering a kind of pain that was beyond human endurance.
Her face was extremely twisted, making it look particularly hideous and terrifying, making people afraid to look directly at it.
Taking a closer look, I saw that the blazing bloody flames on Liang Hongyi were fading at an alarming speed.
Her face also turned pale and bloodless at this moment, and even her breathing became disordered.
Seeing this situation, Chen Yifan's expression suddenly changed. He screamed in his heart, and hurriedly shouted: "No! This is the serious sequelae caused by the captain's forced use of blood rage."
Zhao Yu looked anxious and said, "What should we do?"
At this moment, Liang Hongyi endured the severe pain all over her body and said: "Don't worry about me, the matter is not over yet. Zhao Yu, Chen Yifan, please report the situation here to the bureau, and check whether the members of the sixth team have died."
Hearing this, all the black-clothed guards present were somewhat silent.
Liang Hongyi was a little weak and continued: "The others will form a team of four and continue to follow the traces left by the target. Remember, no matter whether the trace is found or not, do not act rashly!"
After giving these instructions, Liang Hongyi's vision went dark and she fainted on the spot. She just managed to hold on for a breath.
After an unknown amount of time, Lone Wolf took Qin Moxue hostage to an abandoned factory, threw Qin Moxue to the ground, and said with a gloomy face: "Little girl, I don't care what your plans are, you'd better be honest, otherwise..."
Qin Moxue didn't pay attention to the pain coming from her body, but secretly looked around. She knew that her life was beyond her control, like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. She hoped that the things she secretly sprinkled could help her!
Lin Dao used Shunpo and followed him all the way to the abandoned factory. He looked at the lime powder under his feet, his eyes full of admiration, and thought to himself: "In such a dangerous situation, this girl has never given up on survival, and she can still calmly fight for a chance of survival for herself in a desperate situation."
Just because of your character, I will save you once.
Lone Wolf began to meditate to recover from his injuries. If he wanted to escape from the pursuit of the black guards, he had to race against time, otherwise he would die waiting for him.
The black-clad guards of Daxia are taboo in the entire world of extraordinary beings.
This time he was able to escape, but his threat was successful. He sacrificed the lives of a train of people in exchange for the black-clothed guards being unable to take action.
But he didn't expect that some perverts from the acquired world would come out and almost beat him to death.
It made him doubt his life several times.
If he hadn't forcibly kidnapped an ordinary person regardless of his dignity, he would have just left it there.
Qin Moxue looked at the man meditating without making any move. She knew that if the man didn't tie her up, he wouldn't be afraid of running away, and she wouldn't ask for trouble.
What she experienced in these few hours was far more exciting and exciting than her life.
Think of the wonderful battle scene in the station,There were also those magical means and the scenes that happened shocked Qin Moxue's soul, and a kind of palpitations grew from the bottom of her heart.
While Lone Wolf was recovering from his injuries, Lin Dao came behind Qin Moxue in a blink of an eye.
Qin Moxue felt a familiar palpitating feeling in her heart. She was startled, and her vision went black and she fainted.
Lin Dao hit Qin Moxue on the back of the neck before he could react. He didn't want to reveal his identity.
The lone wolf seemed to feel something. He opened his eyes and looked at the young man in front of him. His heart sank. He was not discovered until he came to him silently. He was not able to do it innately.
Although he couldn't detect the young man's strength, based on the experience of being pinned to the ground and rubbed by several young people just now, the young man in front of him was definitely a master.
It's a pity that the lone wolf doesn't know how good this master is.
Without the slightest hesitation, Lone Wolf decided to strike first and shouted angrily in a low voice: "Blood Wolf Flying Blade!"
Following this low roar, an extremely powerful zhenqi suddenly spurted out from Lone Wolf's body.
The entire left hand instantly turned into a terrifying, bloody wolf claw that shone with scarlet light!
